observations: CI at the merge head ddd6873c284d: the changes job was queued when I read it (17:50Z), and no conflicts-script, lint, typecheck or test result exists yet. 0dac5afce6be is handoff-only and has no runs. The pod's python3 has no PyYAML, so I ran check-ci-filters.sh with uv run --with pyyaml==6.0.2. CI's ci-filters job runs it on the runner's Python. The real GitHub skip for a pull request that does not touch scripts/conflicts cannot be seen before the merge: only a branch with this ci.yaml has the job. So the skip proof is the repository's filter model over real file lists.
